thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: east-us-primary gpu_pool saturation > 98% — queue growth detected, autoscaler failing health checks, spillover triggered. Severity: P1.

marta (oncall): I'm awake, pulling logs. Can someone confirm if autoscale job is running?

kevin (sre): Looking into metrics now — HPA reported scale-up pending due to quota error from cloud provider. See snippets: `ScaleUpFailed: InsufficientQuota: GPU quota exceeded for project`

raj (infra): Confirmed. Autoscaler attempted to provision new instances but hit soft quota limit in region. Provider returned 403-ish. Fallback path kicked to cross-region router.

olga (runtime): Router shows spillover to eu-west and west-us. eu-west started returning model-variant-mismatch errors (runtime 422) for several requests — likely incompatible quantized variant. west-us is healthy but at 70% util.

marta (oncall): Customer impact? Any 5xxs or tail latency spikes?

emma (cs): Several customers reporting increased failure rates on streaming endpoints (chat). Initial triage from support: ~12 customers impacted, mostly high-TPS integrations.

cust-success-bot: Automated summary: 12 customers impacted, ~5% error rate, median latency increased from 90ms -> 420ms for affected requests, spike started at ~2465009800.

kevin (sre): We're seeing queue depth climb on east-us primary: 42k requests queued, average enqueue wait 18s. Autoscaler logs show repeated attempts and backoffs: `Attempt 7 -> quota error -> retry backoff`.

raj (infra): Immediate playbook options: 1) manual reroute east-us traffic to west-us-only for model X variants, 2) request emergency quota bump from cloud console (slow), 3) drop low-priority burst requests via throttling.

marta (oncall): I'm going to start manual reroute. Kevin, can you push a temporary route override? Olga, confirm west-us supports the same model variant with acceptable perf.

olga (runtime): West-us has compatible model-x-v2-quant with same tokenizer, estimate ~+5ms per token. Good to route. eu-west will be excluded due to variant mismatch.

kevin (sre): Executing route override now. Command:```
# route override to west-us pool
redwood-routerctl set-policy --from-region east-us --to-region west-us --model model-x --priority emergency-escort
```

kevin (sre): override applied. Starting slow drain of east-us queue with prioritized tokens pinned to west-us.

marta (oncall): Throttling policy? We should protect system from unbounded retries. Raj, can you enable request-shedding for non-SLAs?

raj (infra): Enabled soft-throttle for free-tier and experimental routes: `max_inflight_per_key=8`, `burst_window=30s`. Also bumped retry latency cutoff to 25s — clients will get 503 earlier instead of piling up.

emergency-notes: We should inform top-tier customers and open a bridge.

emma (cs): Sending email & status page update now. Draft: "We're experiencing elevated latencies and errors for model X in east-us while we reroute traffic. Mitigation in progress; temporary routing to west-us applied."

olga (runtime): Note: some in-flight requests retried by clients caused duplicated KV cache seeds. We're enabling idempotency token enforcement for the next 10m to avoid tail amplification.

kevin (sre): Metrics after routing: queue depth in east-us down to 6k within 90s, west-us CPU/GPU load increased to 82% but stable. Error rate dropping from 5% -> 1.2%. Latency back to ~160-210ms for rerouted flows.

marta (oncall): Good. Now let's surface root cause: autoscaler failing due to provider quota + autoscaler backoff logic didn't escalate to admin page after repeated failures. Need postmortem action.

raj (infra): Action items assigned: (1) emergency quota request template + playbook (owner: raj), (2) make autoscaler escalate after N consecutive quota errors to oncall + create a circuit-breaker to avoid queue spiral (owner: kevin), (3) routing policy: prefer west-us warm pools when primary nearing 85% to reduce spillover chaos (owner: olga).

emergency-ops: Can we mark incident severity and handoff? Marta, do you want to keep pager open or handoff to night-ops in 30m?

marta (oncall): I'll stay for the next 45m and then handoff to kevin for simulated-drill monitoring. Please add stretch notes to the ticket.

cust-success-bot: Customer-impact update pushed to status page and queued customers notified via webhook.

kevin (sre): Quick commands used during mitigation (logs sanitized):
```
# show autoscaler failures
redwood-autoscaler logs --since 10m | grep -i quota
# apply route override
redwood-routerctl policy apply emergency-escort.json
# enable throttle
redwood-throttle set --profile emergency-shed --targets free-tier,exp
```

olga (runtime): Long-term notes inline: (a) canonicalize model variants across regions when onboarding (b) add automated variant compatibility checks in routing decision (c) pre-warm west-us for critical customers.

marta (oncall): Putting a brief incident summary for postmortem: "Autoscaler failed to provision due to region GPU quota exhaustion. Router spillover to multiple regions caused mismatched model variant errors in eu-west; manual override to west-us stabilized traffic and reduced error/latency. Customer impact: ~12 customers, degraded latency and ~5% error rate at peak."

kevin (sre): I'll open the incident ticket with timeline + logs, assign action items to owners.

raj (infra): FYI, cloud provider accepted an emergency quota increase request (soft approval) — will take ~17m to provision. If that finishes we can re-balance back to east-us and remove override.

marta (oncall): Keep the override until we verify east-us recovered and queue drained fully. We'll reconvene on bridge if quota doesn't arrive in 20m.

kevin (sre): Monitoring. Current status: mitigated -> stabilizing. Will post final update after quota arrival and a 10m cooling period. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (route override, throttling, idempotency enforcement). Severity: P1 -> P2 (stabilizing). Next update expected at 2465011276 or on quota completion.
